questions.question: Which ability best represents human intelligence that AI tries to imitate?
options: Learning from mistakes and solving problems

questions.question: How is an AI system different from a basic calculator?
options: AI can learn from data and make decisions

questions.question: When a smart speaker converts your voice into text to understand your command, which AI ability is being used?
AI recommends videos on platforms like Instagram Reels mainly by analyzing:
options: Patterns in what you watch or like

questions.question: Which AI technology helps smartphones unlock by recognizing the user’s face?
Which of the following is the best example of Narrow AI?
options: A machine that can perform every human task
An AI that predicts cricket ball trajectories in DRS
A robot that learns all school subjects
A computer that can think like humans in all situations

questions.question: Why is Narrow AI called 'narrow'?
options: It works only on small devices
It specializes in one specific task

questions.question: General AI refers to:
options: AI that can perform only mathematical tasks
AI that works only in robots
AI that has human-like intelligence in many tasks
AI that works only on the internet

questions.question: Which statement about General AI is correct today?
options: It is widely used in schools
It exists only in science fiction

questions.question: Who proposed the famous test to check whether a machine can think like a human?
In the Turing Test, what must a machine do to pass?
options: Convince a human during a text conversation that it is human

questions.question: Which computer defeated world chess champion Garry Kasparov in 1997?
The victory of Deep Blue over Kasparov showed that:
options: Machines can outperform humans in certain logical tasks
Humans are always better at strategy

questions.question: The breakthrough in 2012 that helped computers recognize images and objects was called:
Which AI architecture introduced in 2017 greatly improved language understanding?
Which everyday tool uses AI to predict traffic and suggest the fastest route?
What is the main role of AI in smart assistants like Siri or Alexa?
options: Understanding and responding to voice commands

questions.question: Chatbots on websites are mainly used to:
options: Provide automated help or answers to users

questions.question: Self-driving cars rely on AI mainly to:
options: Change the color of the car

questions.question: Which of the following best summarizes Artificial Intelligence?
options: Machines that can mimic human intelligence such as learning and decision making
